_comment: Before npm run dist / release: run tools/setup_runtime.ps1 (fills python.sha256 + size) then tools/fill-runtime-manifest.cjs --primary/--backup --require-complete. CI release job does this automatically and uploads the Python ZIP as a GitHub Release asset. Empty python.sha256/primary will fail validateResource and block install.
